release_notes: AUTOSSL: fully automated monthly certificate renewal. New scripts/autossl_cron.php scans all certs (ssl_certs + /etc/letsencrypt/live), syncs the inventory to ssl_certs, and renews any certificate expiring within the configured window (default 30 days) via 'certbot renew --cert-name'. Self-gates to once per interval (default 30 days / monthly) through automation_settings.autossl_last_run; --force bypasses the gate. Writes ssl_log + storage/autossl_last_run.json. Monthly cron installed (0 3 1 * *) in both install_debian.sh and the RHEL installer. AutoSSL admin page rebuilt: enable toggle, notification email, renew-days + interval-days, last-run info, and a certificate table with days-left badges; the 'Run AutoSSL Sweep Now' button forces a sweep. Automation settings save persists all autossl_* keys. Verified live: sweep checks 8 certs, syncs all into ssl_certs, renews only expiring ones, and the monthly gate skips a re-run.
